parent.rules_intro: Set once. Every request is checked against these before it reaches you.

min_notice.label: At least {hours} hours notice
min_notice.detail: Same-day changes always come to me.

latest_end.label: Nothing past {time}

same_provider.label: Same therapist only
same_provider.detail: A new face needs my okay first.

cancel_needs_approval.label: Cancelling needs my okay
cancel_needs_approval.detail: Moving is fine. Skipping I decide.

parent.providers_intro: Connect the calendar each provider already keeps, so their sessions show up here on their own.
parent.no_providers: No providers yet. Add one below.
parent.ics_help_intro: Most calendar apps let you share a private link to a calendar. Look in that calendar's settings for something called "Publish calendar" or "Secret address in iCal format," then paste that link above.
parent.ics_help_google: Google Calendar: Settings → pick the calendar → "Integrate calendar" → "Secret address in iCal format"
parent.ics_help_outlook: Outlook / Microsoft 365: Calendar → Settings → "Shared calendars" → "Publish a calendar"
parent.ics_help_apple: Apple Calendar (iCloud): open the calendar's sharing settings → turn on "Public Calendar" → copy the link
parent.picker_hint_pull: Mew will read {name}'s sessions from whichever calendar you pick below — it never changes that calendar.
parent.no_calendars_found: No calendars found on that Google account.
parent.kid_calendars_intro: Connect your kid's own Google Calendar and their schedule will show up there automatically, right alongside everything else they already see.
parent.no_kids_yet: No kids yet. Add one below.
parent.picker_hint_push: Mew will send {name}'s Mew schedule to whichever calendar you pick below — it never reads from that calendar.
parent.kid_calendar_connect_ok: Connected. Their schedule will start appearing there.

kid.note: Asking is always okay. If it fits the rules, it just happens. If not, a note goes out.

provider.note: The answer comes back into your own calendar. Most changes clear themselves.
